title: Protocol-deviation estimand and treatment-policy blinding gate for THOS
hypothesis: A protocol-only estimand contract can reject post-outcome switching among treatment-policy, hypothetical, composite, and principal-stratum strategies and can keep deviation handling blind to favored outcomes.
null_or_failure: An intercurrent-event strategy changes after outcomes, nonadherence is excluded asymmetrically, rescue actions are hidden, the estimand and analysis population disagree, matched budgets diverge, blinding is broken, or synthetic protocol vectors become a superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood result.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate estimand strategy, event timing, adherence status, rescue handling, analysis population, arm label, matched budget, blinding, participant count, rater count, ethics review, and independent review; require every post-outcome or asymmetric switch to fail closed.
rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected synthetic decision, preserve the negative, restore the preregistered estimand and blind deviation rule, and require competent ethics review, consent, real matched-budget arms, real participants and raters as applicable, and independent review before execution.
boundary: Protocol checks do not supply ethics approval, consent, real participants or raters, matched-budget real arms, superiority, or independent review.
